Wyetech is a small business founded in June 2007, built on a simple vision that hasn’t changed since day one: hire awesome people, compensate them well, and channel their enthusiasm into making customers happy. That commitment shows up in our benefits, including a best-in-class retirement plan: Wyetech contributes the equivalent of 20% of your salary to your SEP IRA, helping you build real long-term financial security. Our mission is to give employees the best possible environment to thrive while delivering stellar services and solutions for our customers and their missions. We call it engineering happiness: for our customers, and shared by the talented team that makes it happen.

Software Engineer (SWE) Level 0 – Full Stack Development

Labor Category: Software Engineer (SWE) Skill Level 0 – 25347

Location: Annapolis Junction, MD

Job Description

Wyetech is seeking a Software Engineer (SWE) Level 0 to support the development and maintenance of software products that automate manual workflows, allowing mission customers to focus on more complex challenges.

The selected candidate will join a software development team utilizing Agile methodologies and DevOps principles to deliver high-quality, reliable software solutions.

This position provides an opportunity to develop technical skills in full-stack software engineering, including front-end and back-end development, while contributing to applications supporting mission requirements.

Work Arrangement: This position is performed at a contractor facility and offers flexible work schedules. Telework options may be available depending on tasking and customer approval.

Required Skills/Experience

Basic understanding of object-oriented and structured development methodologies and programming languages.

Ability to develop documentation supporting program technical issues and training situations.

Ability to contribute to software development and maintenance activities using Agile methodologies and DevOps principles.

Software Engineer (SWE) Level 0 – LCAT Description

The Software Engineer develops, maintains, and enhances complex and diverse software systems (e.g., processing-intensive analytics, novel algorithm development, manipulation of extremely large data sets, real-time systems, and business management information systems) based upon documented requirements. Works individually or as part of a team. Reviews and tests software components for adherence to the design requirements and documents test results. Resolves software problem reports. Utilizes software development and software design methodologies appropriate to the development environment. Provides specific input to the software components of system design to include hardware/software trade-offs, software reuse, use of Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS)/Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) in place of new development, and requirements analysis and synthesis from system level to individual software components.

Level 0 Software Engineer Capabilities

The Level 0 Software Engineer (SWE) shall possess the following capabilities:

Analyze user requirements to derive software design and performance requirements.

Debug existing software and correct defects.

Provide recommendations for improving documentation and software development process standards.

Design and code new software or modify existing software to add new features.

Integrate existing software into new or modified systems or operating environments.

Develop simple data queries for existing or proposed databases or data repositories.

Education and Experience Requirements

No demonstrated experience is required.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university is required.

Four (4) years of Software Engineering (SWE) experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications

Full-stack software development experience involving both front-end and back-end technologies.

Java

JavaScript, including Vue.js and React

JSON

Familiarity with MongoDB

Elasticsearch

Grafana

Kibana

Clearance Requirements

TS Clearance with Customer Appropriate Polygraph

Due to federal contract requirements, United States Citizenship and position-appropriate security clearance are required.

Benefits

Wyetech provides a generous PTO plan of up to 200 hours annually, aligned with applicable state leave regulations. Employees have the flexibility to adjust their PTO allocation at the start of each calendar year, ensuring it meets their evolving needs.

Full-time employees have the option to participate in a variety of voluntary benefit plans including:

A Choice of Medical Plan Options, some with Health Savings Account (HSA)

Vision and Dental

Life and AD&D Benefits

Short and Long-Term Disability

Hospital Indemnity, Accident, and Critical Illness Insurances

Optional Identity Theft and Legal Protection Services

Employee Referral Bonus Eligibility up to $10,000

Mobility Among Wyetech-supported Contracts

Various contract and work locations throughout Maryland, Virginia, Colorado, Texas, Utah, Alaska, Hawaii and OCONUS

Various team-building events throughout the year such as monthly lunches, summer company picnic, and an annual holiday party.

Employees receive two complimentary branded clothing orders annually.

Salary Range

$35.97–$48.71 USD Hourly

Hourly pay rates listed for this position serve as a general guideline and are not a guarantee of compensation. Compensation will vary dependent upon factors including but not limited to: Government contract rates; education; relevant prior work experience, knowledge, skills, and competencies; certifications, and geographic location. Hourly pay rates reflect the pre-benefit gross wage amounts.
